info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Expert Sales Support API
info.description: The Product Expert Sales Support API facilitates enhanced interactions with sales experts for banking products. By using this API, businesses can efficiently engage with product experts to address customer inquiries, provide tailored product recommendations, and support the sales process. Typical consumers include sales teams and customer support staff looking to improve customer satisfaction through expert-driven advice. This API serves as a vital resource for organizations aiming to streamline communication and enhance the overall sales experience.
